pre_specified_analysis_details.taxonomy_extension: B-01's b01_analysis.classify_mark is used unchanged except that the B-02 marks, which B-01's taxonomy does not know, are mapped so B-01's components keep their meaning: left mark ep.* -> revalidate / reval_endpoint; left mark mcp.parsed, mcp.session_validated, mcp.tools_list_built, mcp.admission_validated -> driver_pre_dispatch / pre_admission_validate; left mark mcp.identity_applied, mcp.session_begun, mcp.timer_started, mcp.inner_classified, mcp.inner_tools_list_built, mcp.inner_validation_skipped -> driver_pre_dispatch / pre_inner_validate. Finer B-02 sub-spans are reported beside them, never instead.
pre_specified_analysis_details.localized_components: endpoint component = per trial, the sum over mutations inside T of the reval.native_window -> reval.endpoint interval (B-01 sub reval_endpoint); admission component = per trial, the sum over tools/calls inside T of mcp.line_read -> mcp.inner_validated (pre_admission_validate + pre_inner_validate). The gate denominators are the K5 medians of these per class.
pre_specified_analysis_details.saving_definition: per class, paired K5 - K5X T_oracle within round (median, seeded bootstrap 10000, seed 20261002 as PREREG); E gate uses K5 vs K5E, V gate uses K5 vs K5V; S = median K5 / median K5EV (ratio bootstrap over rounds, same seed).
pre_specified_analysis_details.moved_work: CUA_DRIVER_EXP_ENDPOINT_REPROOF=bound adds bound-listener seeding (exp_bind_listener) at bind, before T. Every E arm is therefore also reported as bind + T_oracle end to end (bind call window + T_oracle) paired against K5; work moved before T is never counted as deleted.
pre_specified_analysis_details.trace_cost: the per-mark trace write cost is inside every span in every arm; residual spans are reported as 'including trace overhead', not as Driver work.

W_decision_rule_before_probes.probes: step0_probe.py, 5 trials per class, every knob unset, quiet-timed EXCLUSIVE (label b02-step0-r2), excluded from gates. Per trial: A1/A2 (first and second snapshot of a document), B1/B2 (same after re-navigation, same Driver process and connection), rawC (a second OS process with its own CDP connection and session snapshots the cold re-navigated document first) then Driver C1, D1 (snapshot 1 s after re-navigation), plus the second-Driver bind (E).
W_decision_rule_before_probes.statistics: per class medians of excess_A = A1 - A2, excess_B = B1 - B2, C1 - B2, D1 - B2, and of the attach sub-span excess.
rules: per-process first use: median excess_B <= 25% of median excess_A -> a warm-up could only move the work to prepare/bind ('moved', not a deletion); no knob; W verdict NOT DELETED (moved only).
per-document (first observer pays): median excess_B >= 50% of median excess_A AND median (C1 - B2) <= 50% of median excess_B -> IRREDUCIBLE.

load timing: median excess_B >= 50% of median excess_A AND median (D1 - B2) <= 50% of median excess_B -> IRREDUCIBLE (any fresh observation right after navigation absorbs the document's pending work).

a W knob (per-target CDP session reuse) is built only if the attach sub-span excess plus the per-call attach cost is >= 50% of median excess_A in some class; otherwise not built, because it could not meet the >= 50% deletion gate. If built, it is added as a disclosed extension with its own amendment before its first measured trial.
W_decision_rule_before_probes.otherwise: if no rule fires, the W verdict is UNDECIDED and the remaining excess is named in E2.
